tagline: World-leading provider of heat transfer, separation and fluid handling solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Order intake is the primary demand indicator in the industrial equipment industry and directly reflects the competitiveness of the portfolio and structural growth momentum above market levels.

kpis.name: Order Intake
kpis.explanation: Total value of new orders received by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Order intake reached 70.7 billion SEK in 2023, driven by strong demand across all three divisions. Organic order intake growth was 11%. The Marine Division recorded 24 BSEK (+23%), the Food & Water Division 26.4 BSEK (+20%) including the Desmet acquisition, and the Energy Division 20.4 BSEK at a record level.
kpis.signal: 21% order growth in 2023, driven by industrial projects and acquisitions.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated by the company after deduction of returns and discounts.
kpis.description: Net sales reached 63.6 billion SEK in 2023 with total growth of 22% and organic growth of 12%, driven by strong project activity and recovery in the energy and marine sectors, as well as the Desmet acquisition.
kpis.signal: Total growth of 22% with organic growth of 12%, outpacing the market.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITA Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit before amortization, expressed as a percentage of net sales.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITA margin reached 16.1% in 2023 (10.2 billion SEK), an absolute improvement of 24%, despite inflationary pressures, thanks to efficient operational management and divisional improvements.
kpis.signal: Margin improvement driven by higher productivity and strong fixed cost absorption.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from the company's operating activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow reached a record level of 10 billion SEK in 2023, supported by improved working capital management, increased operational stability, and normalization of global supply chains.
kpis.signal: Record level of cash generated, reflecting improved earnings quality and normalized market conditions.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: Headcount reached 70,742 employees in 2023, reflecting strategic expansion in key sectors such as energy and food following the Desmet acquisition. The creation of a dedicated fuel cell and electrolyzer technology unit also contributes to this growth.
kpis.signal: Headcount growth linked to the Desmet acquisition and expansion in high-demand segments.

kpis.name: Workplace Accidents
kpis.explanation: Number of workplace accidents resulting in at least one day of absence.
kpis.description: 85 accidents with at least one day of absence were recorded in 2023, a stable figure compared to 2022, interrupting the previous years' downward trend. Despite this stagnation, several operating units remained completely accident-free for years, demonstrating the feasibility of zero-accident goals.
kpis.signal: Stabilization in the number of accidents in 2023 after several years of decline, a point of vigilance for safety.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 98.16 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 21.01 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Fuel Cell & Electrolyzer Unit
kpis.explanation: Creation of a dedicated business unit for fuel cell and electrolyzer technologies for the hydrogen economy, based on Alfa Laval's proven plate technology.
kpis.description: In 2023, Alfa Laval established a dedicated business unit for fuel cell and electrolyzer technologies for the hydrogen economy. This strategic decision is based on Alfa Laval's plate technology, developed and proven over decades in heat exchangers, and represents a potentially significant addition as a new technology platform for the group.
kpis.signal: Strategic launch of a new unit to capture the energy transition toward hydrogen.

kpis.name: Energy Transition Orders
kpis.explanation: Orders in hydrogen, carbon capture and e-fuels, marking the first major investments in the global energy transition.
kpis.description: Orders were recorded in 2023 in hydrogen, carbon capture and e-fuels, marking the beginning of a new wave of demand linked to the global energy transition. The Energy Division recorded these first major investments alongside strong demand from the traditional natural gas market as a necessary transition fuel to reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
kpis.signal: First tangible signs of growing investments in the energy transition, particularly in hydrogen production, carbon capture and e-fuels.

risks.title: Dependence on limited titanium suppliers
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in Item 1A with strong language ('serious risks'), it is recurring, and titanium is critical for production. The 'Industrial' category is central to operations.

risks.title: Volatility in raw material prices
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights volatility in steel, copper and titanium prices, with direct impact on costs. The tone is concerned, and the risk has been active for several years.

risks.title: Increased competition in industrial markets
risks.score_rationale: The risk is clearly identified in Item 1A, with assertive language ('competitive markets'), it is structural, and the category is strategic for the company.

risks.title: Potential disruptions in the supply chain
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned with cautious but concerned language ('elevate the risk'), it is evolving with the geopolitical context, and is critical for overall operations.

risks.title: Stringent sector-specific regulatory requirements
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions customers in regulated sectors (marine, food, pharmaceutical), implying high standards. The risk is implied but critical.

risks.title: Conflict minerals-related risks
risks.score_rationale: The risk is documented with due diligence measures, measured but present language, stable trend, and linked to the company's ESG reputation.

risks.title: Cyber threats to industrial operations
risks.score_rationale: Not explicitly mentioned, but inferred from the connected industrial context and operational risks. Language is indirect, but the risk is increasing in the sector.
